name: Yihong Garden
description: Yihongyuan is located in Datang Street. It is gorgeous in shape, resplendent in gold and green, and has a unique charm. In this luxurious building, there are many graceful and versatile women who are famous all over the world for their talents. With the sound of silk and bamboo, singing and dancing, there is an endless stream of tourists who come here every day. Yihongyuan 3D metal puzzle will show you the prosperous Tang Dynasty.
